capabilities: Capture text typed into the Kanban new-card form
List saved drafts with board path, lane label, and capture time
Copy a saved draft to the clipboard
Dismiss recovery records and their earlier versions
Search drafts and set per-board retention limits (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a Kanban board editor; it only observes the new-card form and offers a separate recovery dialog, never inserting cards.
extras: Freemium: capture, copy, and dismiss are free; version history, search, and retention limits require a $5/month or $15 GitHub Sponsors payment. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; untested platforms include mobile, popout windows, and Kanban versions other than 2.0.51.
intentEvidence: This companion needs the Kanban community plugin. The integration uses its released form classes.
problem: The Kanban plugin discards text typed into the Add a card form when a click outside or Escape closes it, with no way to recover it.

relations.evidence: This companion needs the Kanban community plugin. The integration uses its released form classes.

summary: Draft recovery companion for the Kanban plugin that saves text typed into the new-card form and lets you copy it back after the form closes.
